events.title: Brisbane Sculpture Festival 2026
events.description: An open-air exhibition featuring large-scale sculptural works from Queensland artists set along the Manly foreshore, encouraging casual engagement and conversation.

events.title: Wynnum Manly Jazz and Swing Festival
events.description: A local community music festival featuring live jazz and swing performances in an informal park setting, attracting music lovers from across Brisbane.

events.title: Strong Is The New Pretty
events.description: A contemporary theatre production exploring themes of identity and resilience; QPAC often hosts post-show discussions relevant to the season.

events.title: Brisbane Portrait Prize 2026
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: An exhibition showcasing portraiture entries celebrating the people and culture of Brisbane, offering a deep dive into local identity and artistic talent.

events.title: Dearly Departed: death in life
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: A thoughtful exhibition exploring historical and contemporary cultural rituals surrounding death and memory, providing an intellectual perspective on human experience.

events.title: The Edge Screens: Echoes of Brisbane
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: An immersive digital and visual exhibition capturing the history and evolution of Brisbane, hosted within the creative hub of The Edge.

events.title: Billy Missi'n Wakain Thamai
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: An exhibition dedicated to the late Billy Missi, showcasing linocut prints that detail the celestial navigation and culture of Zenadth Kes (Torres Strait).
